definitions.gloss: last third of a month, late (month)
definitions.explanation: The final ten days of a month, approximately the 21st to the end.

examples.japanese: 3⟦{月|がつ}→月：02230_tsuki⟧{下旬|げじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{咲|さ}く→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: Cherry blossoms bloom in late March.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{下旬|げじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I plan to travel at the end of next month.

examples.japanese: {下旬|げじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しく→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Work gets busy toward the end of the month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発売|はつばい}→発売：04315_hatsubai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧12⟦{月|がつ}→月：02230_tsuki⟧{下旬|げじゅん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The release is scheduled for late December.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧{下旬|げじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}す→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧。
examples.english: I'm moving at the end of this month.

notes:
{下旬|げじゅん} refers to the last third of a month (roughly days 21-31).

Month divisions:
- {上旬|じょうじゅん} (first third, ~1st-10th)
- {中旬|ちゅうじゅん} (middle third, ~11th-20th)
- {下旬|げじゅん} (last third, ~21st-end)

Common usage:
- [month]{下旬|げじゅん} (late [month])
- {下旬|げじゅん}に (toward the end of the month)
- {下旬|げじゅん}{頃|ごろ} (around the end of the month)

Related terms:
- {月末|げつまつ} (end of month - more specific)
- {末|まつ} (end)
